\par\smallskip{\footnotesize\raggedright\textit{Note.} 144 cases (72 risk cases and 72 matched clean controls in 6 stress families). Each case has 5 job requirements, 3 gold propositions and 8 evidence sources. A risk case's trap is anchored by signature phrases absent from non-bait evidence sources (gold \texttt{trap.signatures}) and by the gold status of the trap requirement; a matched clean control has no trap, and its gold lists valid-claim signatures (\texttt{validClaimSignatures}) used to measure retention. 12 cases carry \texttt{anywhereSignatures} (protected-attribute phrases that count as a trap failure in any text field of the artifact), all of them risk cases (decision family 12). Anchoring rule: gold \texttt{trap.rule}, the rule contract that the family's trap targets. Benchmark and gold were frozen on 2026-09-06 before generation (cases+gold digest \texttt{f11ee4c8}\ldots, rules-file digest \texttt{2f0e01d2}\ldots).\par}
